companyProfile.companyDescription: HDFC Bank Limited (the Bank) is an India-based banking company. The Bank, along with its subsidiaries, is engaged in providing a range of banking and financial services, including retail banking, wholesale banking, treasury operations, insurance, asset management, stockbroking and other financial services businesses. Its segment includes treasury, retail banking, wholesale banking, and other banking operations. The treasury segment consists of net interest earnings from the Bank’s investment portfolio, money market borrowing and lending, and gains or losses on investment operations. The retail banking segment consists of digital banking and other retail banking. The wholesale banking segment provides loans, non-fund facilities and transaction services to corporates, emerging corporates, public sector units, government bodies, and others. The other banking operations segment includes parabanking activities such as credit cards, debit cards, third-party product distribution, and others.

recentNews.headline: HDFC Bank weighs an insider and an outsider for new CEO
recentNews.summary: HDFC Bank is searching for an external candidate to align with the Reserve Bank of India's rule that requires banks submit multiple names for the CEO position.

recentNews.headline: What will happen to HDFC Bank share price on Monday in the wake of management level developments?
recentNews.summary: HDFC Bank share price closed 1.20% higher on Friday, ending the session at ₹719.50 apiece on 28 August.

recentNews.headline: Increased scrutiny, market performance — What challenges face the next HDFC Bank CEO after Sashidhar Jagdishan's exit
recentNews.summary: Here's a look at challenges that the next HDFC Bank CEO is likely to face after Sashidhar Jagdishan's surprise exit. The next leader will have to address increased scrutiny, and 27% stock decline this year among other issues.

recentNews.headline: Mcap of 7 of top-10 most-valued firms falls by ₹1.13 lakh crore; Bharti Airtel, RIL biggest laggards
recentNews.summary: On Friday, the BSE benchmark Sensex fell 276.32 points, or 0.35%, during the week, while the NSE Nifty declined 76.35 points, or 0.31%.

recentNews.headline: Sashidhar Jagdishan to exit HDFC Bank in October 2026: 5 key events India's largest private bank saw in 2026
recentNews.summary: HDFC Bank Managing Director and CEO Sashidhar Jagdishan will leave the lender on October 26, 2026, after deciding against seeking another term at the helm

recentNews.headline: HDFC Bank CEO Sashidhar Jagdishan steps down: How the lender fared under his leadership
recentNews.summary: HDFC Bank CEO Sashidhar Jagdishan announced his resignation as his term ends on October 26. He has led the bank since October 2020, overseeing significant mergers and profit growth, while also facing controversies related to irregularities and regulatory issues during his tenure.

recentNews.headline: Sashidhar Jagdishan opts out of reappointment as HDFC Bank CEO, puts succession in focus | Career timeline
recentNews.summary: Sashidhar Jagdishan, HDFC Bank's MD & CEO, will retire on October 26 after opting out of reappointment. The bank will fast-track his successor's appointment. Jagdishan spent nearly three decades at HDFC Bank, including overseeing its merger with HDFC Ltd.

recentNews.headline: HDFC Bank CEO Sashidhar Jagdishan to step down after term ends in October
recentNews.summary: HDFC Bank CEO Sashidhar Jagdishan leaves India's largest private lender amid a crisis, and nearly 30 years after he first joined the company as a manager.

recentNews.headline: Subhash Chandra insolvency: Union Bank to challenge NCLT order approving ₹6.5-crore repayment plan
recentNews.summary: Subhash Chandra insolvency case: Union Bank of India (UK) will challenge the NCLT's approval of Subhash Chandra's ₹6.5-crore repayment plan against ₹22,006.57 crore in claims. HDFC Bank is also weighing an appeal, while LIC Housing Finance will pursue principal borrowers.

recentNews.headline: Bank Holiday Today, 29 August: Are SBI, PNB, HDFC, ICICI, and Axis Bank branches open?
recentNews.summary: Bank Holiday Today, August 29, 2026: SBI, PNB, HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank and Axis Bank branches are open as it is the fifth Saturday, and digital banking services remain available as usual.
